payload.name: Drop recipient in relational memory searches
payload.description: When a question asks what one person recommended/suggested/gave to another and the first search returns no supporting memory, retry by dropping the recipient from the query and applying a time filter if a time period is specified.
content: When a question asks what one person <verb> to another (e.g., recommended, suggested, gave) and the initial hybrid search returns no relevant memory, run one additional search using only the subject, verb, and object; omit the recipient from the query and keywords.
If the question includes a time period (e.g., January 2024), add a structured filter on world_start/world_end during that retry so the candidate memory is not outranked by unrelated events.

Use this retry only once to check whether the memory stores the event from the actor's perspective without the recipient; do not apply it when the recipient is essential for disambiguating among multiple candidate memories.

solves: Retrieval misses when the query repeats every participant from the question, but the stored memory records an action only from the actor's perspective and omits the recipient, causing the relevant memory to rank too low. Applies to future questions like 'What city did X recommend to Y in <time>?' when the first search fails. Does not apply when the recipient is the distinguishing attribute and must appear in memory to choose the right answer.
